purpose: Question-specific eligibility for a global financing–fossil-asset-strategy comparison; not a causal design.

observation_period.rule: Exact observed dates govern inclusion; later publication of historical observations is permitted and flagged; fiscal periods extending beyond the end are excluded from the main period.

unit.owner_boundary: Record sovereign or diversified owner without automatically collapsing distinct utility groups; prohibit actual parent/subsidiary double counting.

frame.additional_candidates: Retain only with a predeclared, reproducible importance/coverage rationale; disclose all screened additions.
frame.target: More than 20 independent groups with substantive eligible RQ3 observations; this is a requirement to establish, not an observed count.

common_gates: Verified electric-utility group and dated financing-issuer relationship.
Verified actual qualifying use-of-proceeds bond; frameworks and prospective commitments alone do not qualify.
Instrument type, financial measure type, amount/unit/currency, reporting coverage, and source URL/locator are explicit.
Observed date or bounded annual reporting period is established independently of publication date.
Physical observations identify units, technology, ownership/consolidation basis, operating scope and vintage.
Missing, unknown, contradictory, ineligible, pending extraction and source-confirmed zero have distinct codes.

window_selection.primary_rule: Choose the longest fully comparable source-supported physical endpoint window within the observation period; ties use latest ending date, then stronger finance-date resolution. Nonannual intervals are permitted. Preserve all supported adjacent annual intervals as robustness.
window_selection.comparison_basis_rule: Prefer common-basis same-vintage comparative tables. If they are unavailable, allow a source-supported cross-vintage restatement/scope bridge. Never silently splice.
window_selection.vintage_tie_breaker: For each candidate period use the earliest available report containing both endpoints on the same supported basis; preserve later restatements as a separate sensitivity series.
window_selection.unresolved_date_rule: Do not assign an undated observation to a window; mark pending timing resolution.
window_selection.one_window_display_only: Longest calendar duration, then latest end date, then exact finance cutoff before bounded report-vintage alignment; no selection on outcome.

RQ1longitudinal.estimand: Descriptive continuity or change of observed financing assignments over time.
requirements: Same identified instrument/pool or an explicit supported scope bridge.
Two dated comparable allocation observations with unchanged measure definition or an evidenced reconciliation.
Allocated amount and coverage at each endpoint for monetary continuity.
Project/report-entry identities at both endpoints for membership continuity.
Comparable project weights for monetary-composition continuity; otherwise that subclaim remains unresolved.
RQ1longitudinal.subclaim_denominators: Separate amount continuity, membership continuity and weighted composition.

RQ2maturity.estimand: Allocation-stock association with achieved project implementation states at a dated cutoff, not bond-attributable output.
requirements: Dated actual allocated stock for an identified instrument or pool.
Traceable project/report-entry identities and allocation weights for weighted maturity shares.
Source-supported achieved operational milestones by cutoff.
Unknown status or weights retained explicitly; unknown generation is not zero.
Unique physical-project identities prevent multiplication across financing records.
RQ2maturity.missing_weight_rule: Permit unweighted descriptive project-status evidence only under a separate label; prohibit financial maturity shares.
RQ2maturity.change_claim_rule: Require repeated comparable allocation coverage, weights, states and cutoff definitions.

RQ3samewindowcoexistence.estimand: Observed coexistence of a source-confirmed qualifying green financing state or activity and fossil-asset decisions within a comparable dated operating window.
requirements: At least one dated actual issuance, actual allocation stock, contemporaneously verified identified outstanding green-bond liability, or source-confirmed annual allocation FLOW whose entire reporting period lies within the comparable physical window. Preserve the four financing classes separately; opening-only stock does not establish subsequent persistence.
An allocation stock established only before the opening cannot be assumed to persist; obtain contemporaneous confirmation.
Two comparable physical capacity endpoints on a stable or explicitly bridged ownership/technology basis.
Systematic bounded search for fossil events for the same interval, including annual operating/transaction disclosures and identified event completion records.
Maintain event types, source coverage and residual/unknown states even if no event is identified.
Distinguish issuance-supported from allocation-supported windows in every summary.
A contractual maturity schedule alone does not establish contemporaneous outstanding liability; annual flows are never recast as cumulative stock or allocation continuity.
RQ3samewindowcoexistence.ledger_requirement: A completed bounded search and coded results are required; exhaustive discovery is not presumed. No event found is not no event occurred.
RQ3samewindowcoexistence.output_only_rule: Keep as a separately labelled output trajectory/context analysis until capacity and event evidence support asset-strategy comparison; do not substitute generation for capacity.
RQ3samewindowcoexistence.allowed_claim: Same-window coexistence at the recorded timing resolution.

analysis_rules.denominators: Report groups and windows separately for each RQ and each subclaim.
analysis_rules.group_weighting: Report group-level configurations separately from window counts; no inference treating within-group windows as independent.
analysis_rules.pooling: No physical or financial pooling across incompatible scope/basis/measure classes.
analysis_rules.missingness: Do not replace unknown with zero or absence.
analysis_rules.outstanding_value_basis: Identified outstanding bond liability may be principal, carrying amount or lower bound; preserve source basis and do not pool monetary magnitudes.

review_gates: Reproduce frame/group deduplication and inclusion/exclusion records.
Independently audit window selection for outcome dependence.
Verify key financial and physical source tables and units.
Test amount reconciliation, identity linkage, event classification and timing.
Audit all headline counts and question-specific denominators.
Review contribution, methods/inference and measurement/reproducibility separately.
Finalize 140–150-word abstract only after established sample and results.

amendment_log.authority: Study lead methodological clarifications during source integration
changes: Distinct utility-group unit rather than automatic ultimate sovereign-owner consolidation
Longest comparable source-supported window with nonannual durations; adjacent intervals as robustness
Contemporaneously identified outstanding green liabilities and fully bounded annual allocation flows explicitly accepted as separate RQ3 classes
amendment_log.reason: Preserve actual financing evidence and legitimate endpoint windows without making unsupported persistence or stock/flow claims.
